{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify and count the invalid age values (e.g., -1)
invalid_age_mask = df['customer_age'] == -1
print("Number of invalid age entries (age = -1):", df[invalid_age_mask].shape[0])

# Check if any converted customers have invalid age
invalid_converted_mask = invalid_age_mask & (df['converted'] == 1)
print("Number of converted customers with invalid age (age = -1):", df[invalid_converted_mask].shape[0])

# Drop rows with invalid age (age = -1) for the analysis
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Now compute mean age of converted customers from cleaned data
mean_age_converted = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Cleaned mean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted:.2f}")"}
